summary: Frontend-only Expo/React Native app tested via web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). Home dashboard, 4 feature detail screens with back navigation, banner CTA, and 4-step percorso guidato flow all work as expected. Found ONE real bug: tapping a search suggestion does not navigate to the feature detail (Pressable is dismissed by onBlur before onPress fires on web).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping a search suggestion does NOT navigate to /feature/[route]. URL stays at '/'. Root cause: TextInput.onBlur fires on press-down and sets focused=false, which unmounts the results card (gated by showResults = focused && query.length > 0) before the Pressable's onPress executes on web. Confirmed reproducible with queries 'legge' and 'televisita'.

react_native_issues.component: app/index.tsx home-greeting after returning via router.replace('/')
react_native_issues.issue: After the percorso 'Torna alla home' button (which uses router.replace('/')) two elements with data-testid=home-greeting are present in the DOM momentarily. Home is still functional but the previous route instance appears not fully unmounted. Low priority.

action_items: Fix search-suggestion tap navigation. Recommended approaches: (1) render the results card OUTSIDE the ScrollView / not gated purely on `focused`, keep it while query.length > 0 and add an explicit outside-tap dismiss; OR (2) delay the blur handler (e.g. setTimeout(() => setFocused(false), 150) in onBlur) so the Pressable's onPress can fire; OR (3) use onPressIn on the result Pressable to trigger navigation before blur completes; OR (4) keep the input focused when clicking a result via onMouseDown.preventDefault on web.
Optional: investigate duplicate home-greeting DOM after router.replace('/') from percorso completed screen.
critical_code_review_comments: Search results dropdown depends on `focused` state that toggles via TextInput blur; this pattern is fragile on web. Consider decoupling visibility from focus.
keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' is set on ScrollView but does not help here because the underlying issue is React state (`focused`) hiding the Pressable before onPress fires.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (11/12 flows passing; search-suggestion tap navigation broken)

seed_data_creation: None. All data is static mock in /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.ts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focus retest on: (1) type in search bar and tap a suggestion -> must navigate to /feature/<route> and clear query; (2) ensure clicking outside dismisses results without dismissing before Pressable onPress. Everything else (home rendering, 4 feature cards + back, banner->percorso, 4-step wizard with disabled Avanti, progress %, Concludi, completed summary, Torna alla home) is confirmed working.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open home, focus search input, type 'legge', tap the first result row. Expected: navigate to /feature/diritti and show 'Diritti e Legge 104'. Actual: URL remains '/'. RCA: The results card visibility is `showResults = focused && query.length > 0`. On web, pressing the Pressable causes the TextInput to blur first, which sets focused=false and unmounts the results before the Pressable's onPress callback runs, so navigation never happens. Mitigation options listed in action_items.
